competency: Persist selected processed columns with Snapshot and reopen the result.
acceptance: The output contains the expected tree, row count and selected columns.

competency: Diagnose an output Snapshot that accidentally stores the wrong schema or omits a required derived column.
acceptance: Tests compare intended and actual output columns and require the minimum useful schema.

competency: Create a reduced analysis dataset with Snapshot, reopen it and continue a second-stage RDataFrame analysis.
acceptance: A second-stage action on the persisted dataset reproduces expected values without depending on the original dataframe.

competency: Name sequential filters and use Report to inspect per-cut survival.
acceptance: Visible tests verify per-cut all/pass counts.

competency: Diagnose which cut unexpectedly removes events instead of judging only the final event count.
acceptance: A pipeline with one incorrect cut is localized using per-cut counts rather than only the final result.

competency: Use a cutflow and a post-selection histogram together to explain both selection efficiency and the shape of survivors.
acceptance: Tests verify cut survival and final histogram contents from the same selection chain.

competency: Use a small pure C++ helper from Define for a reusable calculation.
acceptance: The helper is tested independently and its derived column matches expected values.

competency: Recognize why helper code used under implicit multithreading must avoid unsafe shared mutable state.
acceptance: The accepted implementation is deterministic and pure; the exercise does not rely on reproducing a flaky race.

competency: Use a pure C++ helper inside a selected RDataFrame pipeline that remains correct with implicit multithreading enabled.
acceptance: Single-thread and implicit-MT runs produce the same deterministic selected results.

source_concept: multiple concurrent RDataFrame runs with RunGraphs
competency: Run independent RDataFrame result graphs together with RunGraphs.
acceptance: Two deterministic sample graphs produce their expected independent results.

competency: Recognize that dereferencing each sample result before RunGraphs defeats the intended concurrent scheduling pattern.
acceptance: The exercise contrasts the scheduling structure without using wall-clock timing as the correctness oracle.

source_concept: multiple dataframes with shared analysis logic
competency: Apply the same derived quantity and selection to two samples, run them together and compare their resulting summaries.
acceptance: Both samples use the same analysis definition and produce independently verified counts or histograms for comparison.

competency: Use Redefine when values change but the semantic meaning of an existing column is intentionally preserved.
acceptance: Downstream analysis sees the updated values under the original column name.

source_concept: Redefine versus defining a distinct quantity
competency: Recognize when Redefine would hide a change of meaning and a new Define is clearer.
acceptance: Two candidate transformations are contrasted so preserving a misleading column name fails the semantic acceptance case.

competency: Apply a calibration-like correction with Redefine and reuse the unchanged downstream selection/action chain.
acceptance: The same downstream logic produces corrected deterministic outputs after the column update.
